description: This file defines the interface for rbus filter objects, including creation, management, and application of relation and logic filters for evaluating boolean expressions on values. It includes enum definitions for operators, function prototypes for filter initialization, retention, release, application, and comparison, as well as accessors for internal members.

methods.name: rbusFilter_InitRelation
methods.description: Creates a relation filter with a specified operator and comparison value.

methods.name: rbusFilter_InitLogic
methods.description: Creates a logic filter combining one or two filters with a logical operator.

methods.name: rbusFilter_Retain
methods.description: Increases shared ownership of a filter.

methods.name: rbusFilter_Release
methods.description: Releases ownership of a filter, freeing resources if no longer used.

methods.name: rbusFilter_Apply
methods.description: Evaluates the filter against a given value, returning true or false.

methods.name: rbusFilter_GetType
methods.description: Returns the expression type of the filter (relation or logic).

methods.name: rbusFilter_GetRelationOperator
methods.description: Returns the relation operator used in a relation filter.

methods.name: rbusFilter_GetRelationValue
methods.description: Returns the comparison value used in a relation filter.

methods.name: rbusFilter_GetLogicOperator
methods.description: Returns the logical operator used in a logic filter.

methods.name: rbusFilter_GetLogicLeft
methods.description: Returns the left operand filter of a logic filter.

methods.name: rbusFilter_GetLogicRight
methods.description: Returns the right operand filter of a logic filter.

methods.name: rbusFilter_fwrite
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of the filter to a file stream for debugging.
